summary: Polibeli Group Ltd furnished a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, announcing unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenues fell 34.62% to US$10.80 million from US$16.52 million, while gross profit declined 14.78% to US$0.94 million and gross margin improved to 8.71%. Separately, the Company disclosed it is evaluating enterprise AI cloud computing and its PoliVara AI Model-as-a-Service platform, which generated no revenue in the period. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is a routine earnings and strategic-update filing, not a special situation.
